Garden maintenance Eltham

An established garden, kept at its best

Eltham gardens are something special: big native plantings, mature trees, mudbrick character and plenty of slope. They're also a lot of work to keep healthy. Our garden maintenance programs in Eltham take that work off your hands with scheduled visits from a qualified horticulturalist team.

Like our lawn programs, there are three levels: Good, Great and Amazing. Each one is all-inclusive. Pest and disease control, fertilising, weed control and every bit of pruning, hedging and trimming are covered, so the garden keeps improving rather than just getting tidied.

Garden programs pair perfectly with a lawn care program. Many clients choose a Great Lawn Program with a Good Garden Program.

Covered across our garden programs

  • Pest and disease control
  • Fertilising
  • Weed control in beds and paths
  • All pruning
  • Hedging and shaping
  • Trimming and general tidying

Mix & match lawn and garden

Lawn and garden programs are chosen separately, so you only pay for the level you want in each part of the yard. One of our most common combinations is a Great Lawn Program with a Good Garden Program: a standout lawn, with tidy, healthy garden beds around it.

How it works

Starting a garden maintenance program

  1. Garden walk-through

    We look at your plants, beds and problem areas and talk about what you want.

  2. Choose your level

    Good, Great or Amazing, with or without a lawn program.

  3. Scheduled visits

    Regular visits cover pruning, weeding, feeding and treatments.

  4. Season by season

    We adjust the work through the year as the garden changes.

FAQ

Garden Programs FAQs

What's included in a garden maintenance program?

Programs cover pest and disease control, fertilising, weed control and all pruning, hedging and trimming. The exact visit frequency and treatments depend on the level you choose, and we'll confirm them in your quote.

Do you maintain body corporate gardens?

Yes. We're fully insured and maintain body corporate, strata and commercial gardens on a schedule.

Can I combine a garden program with a lawn program?

Yes, they're designed to mix and match. A Great Lawn Program with a Good Garden Program is one of our most popular combinations.

Do you do one-off garden clean-ups too?

Yes. See our garden tidy-ups for one-off weeding, pruning and hedging.
